texts.title:
Poor marks for America’s response to
coronavirus outbreak
texts.subtitle:
% who say each has done a ___ job dealing with the
coronavirus outbreak
texts.source:
Note: Percentages are medians based on 13 countries. Those who
did not answer are not shown.
Source: Summer 2020 Global Attitudes Survey. Q10a-e.
“U.S. Image Plummets Internationally as Most Say Country Has
Handled Coronavirus Badly”
